def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    # Grid separator color is the dominant value on the detected separator rows/columns.

from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    hlines = [r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if sum(v != bg for v in row) > w/2]
    vlines = [c for c in range(w) if sum(grid[r][c] != bg for r in range(h)) > h/2]
    # Grid separator color is the dominant value on the detected separator rows/columns.
    linevals = [grid[r][c] for r in hlines for c in range(w)] + [grid[r][c] for c in vlines for r in range(h)]
    linecolor = Counter(linevals).most_common(1)[0][0]
    marked = [(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(hlines) for j,c in enumerate(vlines) if grid[r][c] != linecolor]
    if not marked:
        return []
    rlo, rhi = min(i for i,j in marked), max(i for i,j in marked)
    clo, chi = min(j for i,j in marked), max(j for i,j in marked)
    rs, cs = hlines[rlo:rhi+1], vlines[clo:chi+1]
    out=[]
    for ra,rb in zip(rs,rs[1:]):
        row=[]
        for ca,cb in zip(cs,cs[1:]):
            corners=[grid[ra][ca],grid[ra][cb],grid[rb][ca],grid[rb][cb]]
            row.append(corners[0] if corners[0] != linecolor and all(x==corners[0] for x in corners) else bg)
        out.append(row)
    return out
